title: National Museum of Play at The Strong

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: The Strong offers a wide range of educational programs for students amid dynamic, hands-on exhibits and world-renowned collections. Field trips can be adapted to meet the needs of teachers or utilized by homeschoolers. See Group Reservation FAQs to learn more. The Strong Museum is an ideal destination for school groups to explore and learn on their own. Self-guided field trips provide schools and other groups the opportunity to explore the museum independently. Self-guided field trips are only available Monday-Friday during the school year (September to June). Self-guided field trips cost $14 per student. There is an additional $6 per student to include the Dancing Wings Butterfly Garden. A
